description.value: The Waffle Co. is an artisan dessert café chain founded in 2017, originally from India with 125+ locations worldwide, now expanding into British Columbia with three locations including this one on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End. The café serves indulgent waffles, specialty coffees, matcha drinks, thick shakes, and other dessert-forward treats. Its location near Stanley Park and English Bay places it along a popular cycling corridor, with both indoor and outdoor seating available.
